celebration: Easter Sunday of the Resurrection of the Lord

sections.title: First Reading
sections.body:
In those days: Peter opened his mouth and said: "You yourselves know
what happened throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee after the
baptism that John proclaimed."

sections.title: Responsorial Psalm
sections.body:
**This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.**

Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; for his steadfast love
endures for ever.

sections.title: Second Reading
sections.body:
Brothers and sisters: If then you have been raised with Christ, seek
the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.

sections.title: Gospel Acclamation
sections.body:
Christ, our paschal lamb, has been sacrificed; let us therefore
celebrate the festival.

sections.title: Gospel
sections.body:
Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early,
while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from
the tomb.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.body:
The empty tomb is not the end of the story but its beginning. What do we
carry back from the garden this morning?

sections.title: Saint of the Day
sections.body:
The Solemnity of the Resurrection displaces the ordinary sanctoral
calendar today.

sections.title: Intercessions
sections.body: Let us pray to the risen Lord. A brief silence is kept after each intention. **Lord, hear our prayer.**
